svg.text: LT1-A03 · Powered truck / frame connection concept
Functional load paths and proposed stations · connection sizing is not released
Main frame → vertical load supports / suspension → truck frame → axlebox springs → bearings / axle → wheels → rail
Yaw pivot and separate traction/brake reaction transfer must allow bounce, roll and lateral movement without binding.
Motor and supported reduction ride on the truck. Final axle drives need articulated joints and torque reaction members.
Four locomotive support groups require a stiffness/equalization solution; the drawn springs do not establish load sharing.
Spring rates, travel, pivot/side-bearing sizes, retaining joints, welds, bolt patterns and fit tolerances are deliberately not assigned.
PF-LOCO-LT1-R0 · Diagram is functional and not to scale; use A01/A02 for arrangement stations
